title: 200 derivation targets for the source-defined sign workstreams and connected finite-QM program
request: please give me a long exhaustive list of things to derive.
scope: Targets 1-140 concern sign representations and concrete model families; 141-200 concern linked finite-QM foundations. This is a scoped research agenda, not a claim that every item is unsolved or that all possible QM problems are enumerated.

kind_legend.R: Explicit proof or counterexample exercise; some already have written arguments and need independent proof/formalization.
kind_legend.F: Source-bound family derivation or finite replay; not an asymptotic theorem.
kind_legend.C: Conditional theorem or imported interface requiring explicitly declared hypotheses.
kind_legend.O: Larger research objective; no claim of a known short solution.

targets.title: Phase normalization
targets.task: Derive q=abs(w)/W, s=w/abs(w), and E_q s=Z/W for integrable w with Z>0; handle its zero set.

targets.title: Exact positivity criterion
targets.task: Prove Z/W=1 iff w>=0 almost everywhere, assuming positive real Z and finite W.

targets.title: Complex phase versus real sign
targets.task: Derive complex reweighting and exhibit failure of replacing the phase by sign(Re w).

targets.title: Finite versus limiting severity
targets.task: Prove g_N=-log(d_N)/V_N tending to g gives d_N=exp(-V_N*g+o(V_N)).

targets.title: Zero-rate counterexample
targets.task: Prove d_N=2^(-floor(sqrt(N))) has zero exponential rate and superpolynomial inverse-square phase penalty.

targets.title: Path-dependent asymptotics
targets.task: Construct different limiting phase rates along different beta,N paths and state a sufficient path-independence condition.

targets.title: Polynomial phase bound
targets.task: Derive the denominator guarantee from d>=1/P(N,beta), separating remaining observable and algorithm costs.

targets.title: Complete configuration support
targets.task: Prove a finite enumeration exhausts the declared model support; distinguish selected fields from an ensemble.

targets.title: Continuous configuration identities
targets.task: Extend reweighting and blocking to continuous measures under explicit absolute-integrability hypotheses.

targets.title: Actual target identification
targets.task: Specify each L0 model's Hamiltonian or transfer, sector, beta, scalar convention, and observables; prove what is calculated.

targets.title: Inserted-numerator preservation
targets.task: Prove Z'=cZ and N'_O=cN_O with c>0 preserve normalized expectations.

targets.title: Composition of exact maps
targets.task: Prove identity and composition for representation changes, scalar factors and observable maps.

targets.title: Unitary observable transport
targets.task: For H'=UHU*, derive the required transformed observables and partition/numerator identities.

targets.title: HS prefactor accounting
targets.task: Derive every global and field-dependent scalar for one exact HS change.

targets.title: Moment-vector pushforward
targets.task: Prove blockwise summation of (w,n_1,...,n_m) preserves partition and every insertion.

targets.title: Moment operad laws
targets.task: Prove arity-zero, identity, associativity and permutation laws for componentwise moment addition.

targets.title: Zero-weight decoding
targets.task: Prove ordinary estimators exist on a zero-weight block exactly when all its inserted numerators vanish.

targets.title: Absolute-weight contraction
targets.task: Prove W'<=W under blocking and characterize equality by common phase in each block.

targets.title: Phase versus observable variance
targets.task: Construct exact blocking that improves average phase but worsens a declared estimator's variance.

targets.title: Product representations
targets.task: Derive tensor weights/local insertions and compatibility with blocking and normalization.

targets.title: Exact denominator variance
targets.task: For M iid unit phases of mean d>0, prove relative phase variance (1-d^2)/(M*d^2).

targets.title: Finite-sample ratio confidence
targets.task: For abs(f)<=B, bound additive error of bar(sf)/bar(s) in d,B,epsilon,eta, including small denominators.

targets.title: Residual covariance formula
targets.task: Under a multivariate CLT, derive ratio asymptotic covariance from s(f-mu), including complex observables.

targets.title: CLT versus MSE
targets.task: Give sufficient uniform-integrability conditions or an example separating ratio CLT from MSE convergence.

targets.title: Identity observable exception
targets.task: Prove f=1 yields an exact ratio whenever the sampled denominator is nonzero.

targets.title: Positive rare-event variance
targets.task: Derive mean 1 and variance 2^N-1 for q=(2^-N,1-2^-N), f=(2^N,0), without claiming universal hardness.

targets.title: Denominator failure control
targets.task: Bound P(abs(bar(s))<d/2) and define honest treatment of zero denominators.

targets.title: Finite-sample ratio bias
targets.task: Bound ratio bias under explicit denominator and moment assumptions; separate physical approximation bias.

targets.title: Control variates
targets.task: Derive an optimal control-variate coefficient with a known expectation and its residual-variance guarantee.

targets.title: Initialization error
targets.task: Decompose nonstationary sampling error into initialization, dependence, finite-sample and ratio terms.

targets.title: Exact arithmetic costs
targets.task: Bound operation counts and rational numerator/denominator bit growth for a chosen determinant algorithm.

targets.title: Confidence-to-cost theorem
targets.task: Combine an estimator bound with update, estimator, setup and precision costs under a declared input encoding.

targets.title: Spectral-gap covariance bound
targets.task: For a stationary reversible chain with nontrivial eigenvalue moduli <=rho<1, bound integrated residual covariance.

targets.title: Autocorrelation versus mixing
targets.task: Construct a fast observable on a chain with a slow unobserved mode; refute global mixing from one measured correlation.

targets.title: Balance versus rapid mixing
targets.task: Construct reversible irreducible finite chain families with bottlenecks and slow mixing.

targets.title: Certified burn-in
targets.task: Derive burn-in from a declared gap, conductance or coupling certificate and initial law.

targets.title: Vanishing determinants
targets.task: Prove support and insertion rules at zero determinants; distinguish inverse estimators from cofactor formulations.

targets.title: Construction and normalization cost
targets.task: Price computation and precision of a normalization factor or basis rather than treating closed form as efficiency.

targets.title: Positive spectral existence
targets.task: Derive positive eigenbasis weights for finite Hermitian H and identify the uncontrolled construction/estimator costs.

targets.title: Accuracy conventions
targets.task: Separate additive from relative error near zero observable means and state a valid zero-mean convention.

targets.title: Creation/annihilation signs
targets.task: Derive (-1)^(occupied earlier modes) from the ordered occupation basis.

targets.title: Finite CAR proof
targets.task: Prove anticommutation, nilpotency and occupation-projector identities in the finite Fock construction.

targets.title: Hamiltonian reconstruction
targets.task: Derive Hubbard hopping and diagonal entries from CAR, orbital order, interaction and chemical-potential conventions.

targets.title: Sector dimensions
targets.task: Prove dimension binomial(L,N_up)*binomial(L,N_down) and number conservation.

targets.title: Exact coefficient field
targets.task: Prove field membership of model and transfer entries; list extensions needed by spectral or normalization operations.

targets.title: Thermal trace positivity
targets.task: Prove Tr(exp(-beta H))>0 for finite Hermitian H and finite real beta.

targets.title: Free triangle analytics
targets.task: Derive the two-identical-fermion triangle spectrum and partition under a fixed hopping convention.

targets.title: Free ring control
targets.task: Derive one-particle/canonical spectra and thermal trace, then compare to the finite-step transfer.

targets.title: Canonical/grand-canonical relation
targets.task: Prove the fugacity generating identity when [H,N]=0; distinguish ensemble observables.

targets.title: Closed-path enumeration cost
targets.task: Count closed paths in a transfer trace and distinguish dense matrix evaluation from explicit path enumeration.

targets.title: Meron bond transfer
targets.task: Exponentiate the two-site spinless interacting Hamiltonian and derive its four-by-four transfer with CAR signs.

targets.title: Meron normalization
targets.task: Derive the q^(-1/4) factor per plaquette and its total checkerboard power.

targets.title: Meron breakup identity
targets.task: Prove vertical weight 1 and horizontal weight (q-1)/2 reproduce all local normalized entries for q>=1.

targets.title: Cluster reconstruction
targets.task: Prove graph components are exactly admissible clusters, including periodic spacetime identifications.

targets.title: Orientation sign character
targets.task: Derive s_g(f)=(-1)^(m_g dot f) from reconstructed occupations rather than assigned labels.

targets.title: Orbit completeness
targets.task: Prove all 2^k flips are distinct, admissible, equal-magnitude and exhaustive.

targets.title: Zero-meron positivity
targets.task: Sum the Boolean sign character and prove exactly which orbits have nonnegative partition contribution.

targets.title: Observable Fourier selection
targets.task: Derive the signed numerator from the observable's Boolean Fourier coefficient at the meron character.

targets.title: Squared staggered estimator
targets.task: Derive zero-meron and two-meron squared-occupation insertion formulas from cluster sizes.

targets.title: Observable-carrying zero-weight orbit
targets.task: Exhibit a real Meron orbit with zero partition and nonzero squared-observable numerator; retain both moment records.

targets.title: Repulsive HS identity
targets.task: Prove the centered spin-channel local identity on all four occupations, including common scalar C.

targets.title: Attractive HS identity
targets.task: Prove the charge-channel identity and derive h^(-sum s) after spin factorization.

targets.title: Interaction conventions
targets.task: Derive shifted mu and constant relating U*n_up*n_down to the centered interaction, including the partition factor.

targets.title: Palindromic kinetic matrix
targets.task: Prove reality, symmetry, positive definiteness and determinant one for the declared rational bond palindrome.

targets.title: Bipartite inverse symmetry
targets.task: Derive eta*K*eta=K^(-1) from bipartite bond structure and the exact palindrome schedule.

targets.title: Half-filled determinant pairing
targets.task: Track transposes/time order at z=1 and derive the positive up/down determinant relation.

targets.title: Attractive square positivity
targets.task: Prove spin-matrix equality and nonnegative real square times the full charge-channel scalar.

targets.title: Full HS reconstruction
targets.task: Prove all-field sums reproduce the declared finite Fock transfer with complete normalization.

targets.title: Particle-number insertion
targets.task: Derive N_num=(z/M)*dZ_tilde/dz for the M-slice number-conserving transfer.

targets.title: Singular-field insertion formula
targets.task: Derive product-rule/cofactor numerators valid at zero field determinants and compare to inverse-based estimators.

targets.title: Generalized eigenvalue pairing
targets.task: Prove antiunitary commutation bijects generalized eigenspaces at lambda and conjugate(lambda).

targets.title: Even real multiplicity
targets.task: For T^2=-I, prove real generalized eigenspaces have even complex dimension without diagonalizability.

targets.title: Non-Hermitian Kramers positivity
targets.task: Combine conjugate pairs and even real multiplicities to prove det(I+B)>=0, including eigenvalue -1.

targets.title: Reality is insufficient
targets.task: Give a real B with negative det(I+B), explaining the failure of square-+1 conjugation protection.

targets.title: Equal versus conjugate factors
targets.task: Show conjugate determinants give absolute squares, while equal complex determinants can square negatively.

targets.title: Protected ring replay
targets.task: Independently reconstruct all fields and number insertions for L=4,M=2,r=3/2,h=2,z=1.

targets.title: Attractive triangle replay
targets.task: Independently reconstruct all fields at L=3,M=2,r=3/2,h=2,z=3/2, including charge prefactors.

targets.title: Two-site reconstruction control
targets.task: Match auxiliary and independent Fock transfer sums for both interaction signs and a number insertion.

targets.title: Finite Meron control
targets.task: Match orbit and occupation-transfer partition/squared-observable numerators at L=4,M=2,q=3.

targets.title: Scaling-driver scope
targets.task: Identify omitted scalars and insertions in the determinant-only lane and prove which reported quantities remain valid.

targets.title: Doped-ring negative witness
targets.task: Independently rebuild mask 15721 at L=4,M=4,r=2,h=8,z=2 and certify both spin determinant signs.

targets.title: Full-ring phase information
targets.task: Separate the singleton witness from complete signed/absolute sums; bound or compute the latter before claiming a full mean phase.

targets.title: Physical ring parameters
targets.task: Recover delta_tau*t, delta_tau*abs(U), delta_tau*shifted_mu and the finite-product target from r,h,z.

targets.title: Broken half-filled protection
targets.task: Identify the precise determinant-pairing step that fails at z=2 without inferring all fields are negative.

targets.title: Nontrivial ring observable
targets.task: Derive a total-number or double-occupancy numerator with all derivative and normalization terms.

targets.title: Field symmetry tests
targets.task: Determine actions of spin flip, translation and reflection on ring weights/insertions; prove which are actually sign reversing.

targets.title: Exact ring blocks
targets.task: Construct blocks or a group action preserving every declared insertion, including zero-weight fibres.

targets.title: Strict finite ring improvement
targets.task: Prove W'<W or d'>d for a candidate on its declared full support and include construction cost.

targets.title: Ring estimator comparison
targets.task: Bound before/after residual variance, estimator cost and dependence instead of comparing phase alone.

targets.title: Growing doped-ring family
targets.task: Give a uniform exact construction with proved cost and phase bounds; retain finite-instance status if no extension is established.

targets.title: Triangle negative witness
targets.task: Independently verify mask 1281 at L=3,M=4,r=2,h=8,z=1 and both determinant signs.

targets.title: Frustration versus doping
targets.task: Identify separately the failed protection hypotheses for triangle z=1 and bipartite ring z=2.

targets.title: Bipartite sign criterion
targets.task: Prove a sublattice sign reversing every hopping bond exists iff the graph is bipartite; apply to a triangle.

targets.title: Gauge versus flux change
targets.task: Prove local phase gauges preserve loop flux and determine when flux threading changes the physical model.

targets.title: Triangle gauge classification
targets.task: Classify admitted orbital/occupation diagonal gauges and restrict any obstruction to that class.

targets.title: Attractive triangle comparison
targets.task: Derive charge-channel positivity on the same geometry and show why geometry alone does not decide positivity.

targets.title: Alternative exact triangle decouplings
targets.task: Derive two representations of the same transfer, transporting scalar factors and insertions before phase comparison.

targets.title: Triangle orbit moments
targets.task: Compute symmetry-orbit sums and test absolute-weight contraction without losing insertion moments.

targets.title: Triangle basis/observable transport
targets.task: Derive transformed interactions and insertions for a proposed unitary basis change and price their evaluation.

targets.title: Growing frustrated family
targets.task: Construct a uniform exact reduction or a narrowly specified no-go theorem for a growing triangle-based interacting family.

targets.title: Configuration gauge criterion
targets.task: Prove a diagonal +/-1 gauge makes all off-diagonal entries nonpositive iff every configuration-cycle edge-sign product is positive.

targets.title: Signed-cover correctness
targets.task: Prove reachability (v,+1) to (v,-1) iff a negative closed walk exists; otherwise reconstruct a consistent gauge.

targets.title: Ring negative configuration cycle
targets.task: Reconstruct the recorded four-site CAR cycle and prove diagonal U cannot change its edge-sign obstruction.

targets.title: Physical-tree exchange obstruction
targets.task: Rebuild the star's negative many-particle cycle and explain why a physical tree can have exchange loops.

targets.title: Open-chain gauge control
targets.task: Derive a consistent gauge for the declared open nearest-neighbor chain and orbital order.

targets.title: Canonical-sector embedding
targets.task: Prove how number-sector projection changes full-Fock partition and insertion comparisons.

targets.title: Nonnegative Euler conditions
targets.task: For stoquastic H, derive step-size/shift conditions making I-delta*H entrywise nonnegative and track target changes.

targets.title: Stoquastic Gibbs positivity
targets.task: Prove exp(-beta*H) is entrywise nonnegative for real Hermitian H with nonpositive off-diagonals and beta>=0.

targets.title: Reconcile representation-specific signs
targets.task: Explain why an occupation gauge obstruction does not contradict auxiliary positivity, tracking ensemble differences explicitly.

targets.title: Precise restricted hardness
targets.task: Specify transformation class, encoding and accuracy before importing hardness; do not infer fermionic-HS hardness from qubit claims.

targets.title: Euler approximation bound
targets.task: Derive an explicit norm bound for (I-beta*H/M)^M-exp(-beta*H) with stated hypotheses and M dependence.

targets.title: Discretization-induced signs
targets.task: Give a concrete finite Euler example whose signs or normalization differ from the Gibbs representation.

targets.title: Positive Euler trace condition
targets.task: Derive a spectral step-size condition making the Euler matrix positive definite and its power trace positive.

targets.title: Energy-shift accounting
targets.task: Prove Gibbs energy shifts give a scalar factor while finite Euler shifts need not do so.

targets.title: Lie-Trotter error
targets.task: Derive an explicit finite bounded-operator product error controlled by commutators and time.

targets.title: Strang error
targets.task: Derive a symmetric-product bound with declared nested-commutator constants rather than only an asymptotic order.

targets.title: Rational transfer/coupling dictionary
targets.task: Identify exact local exponentials represented by r,h,z and the noncommuting global product still approximated.

targets.title: Observable approximation bound
targets.task: Bound normalized-expectation error from partition/numerator errors using a positive denominator lower bound.

targets.title: Finite-lattice locality
targets.task: Prove a Lieb-Robinson bound for declared finite-range interaction norms and certify numerical constant enclosures.

targets.title: Interacting ladder admission
targets.task: For L0-08 reconstruct H, Euler transfer and an insertion; certify denominator admissibility or retain the failed parameter choice.

targets.title: CT-AUX expansion identity
targets.task: Derive the exact shifted-Hubbard expansion used by the sampler, including K-dependent normalization.

targets.title: Thermal Green function
targets.task: Derive both imaginary-time branches, equal-time convention and antiperiodicity from the one-particle spectrum.

targets.title: Scalar/vectorized kernel parity
targets.task: Prove agreement with the derived Green function at negative eigenvalues and time boundaries, not merely agreement between implementations.

targets.title: Vertex integration measure
targets.task: Derive order factorials, site/time/spin measures and proposal-volume factors in CT-AUX weights.

targets.title: Insertion/removal balance
targets.task: Derive detailed-balance acceptance ratios from the actual target and proposal, including zero weights.

targets.title: Fast update correctness
targets.task: Prove Schur-complement/rank-one determinant and inverse updates, with invertibility and fallback conditions.

targets.title: Numerical drift control
targets.task: Derive residual/interval certificates for determinant signs and inverse updates; distinguish exact identities from floating stabilization.

targets.title: Expansion-tail control
targets.task: If an order cutoff is used, bound omitted weight from operator norms; otherwise prove absence of a hidden cutoff.

targets.title: Physical CT-AUX observables
targets.task: Derive particle-number and double-occupancy estimators from the expansion, including singular configurations.

targets.title: CT-AUX correctness gate
targets.task: Establish stationary-law correctness and independent small-model agreement before any phase, speedup or mixing scaling claim.

targets.title: Complete cancellation consequence
targets.task: Prove a fixed-point-free sign-reversing equal-magnitude involution on full support gives Z=0; identify needed unpaired sectors.

targets.title: GIN query soundness
targets.task: Prove every returned partner satisfies the full involution and weight constraints, not just shared index keys.

targets.title: Sliding-window preservation
targets.task: Derive unmatched-moment bookkeeping needed when configurations are evicted from a streaming window.

targets.title: Unique pair ownership
targets.task: Prove insertion/deletion/query rules count every configuration and cancellation exactly once.

targets.title: Streaming normalization
targets.task: Prove the quotiented estimator targets the original quantity; identify any changed window distribution instead.

targets.title: Synthetic generator boundary
targets.task: Trace GIN configuration generation and prove exactly which indexing claims, rather than Gibbs-measure claims, it supports.

targets.title: Complex CDT determinant phase
targets.task: Derive determinant/abs(determinant) and quantify the error from substituting sign(Re determinant).

targets.title: Simplicial Dirac adjoints
targets.task: Prove kinetic adjoint relations and track mass, mu, orientation and boundary effects on the full matrix.

targets.title: Topological obstruction admission
targets.task: For one concrete family establish the gapped phase, invariants and locality/design hypotheses before importing an intrinsic-sign theorem.

targets.title: Homotopy scope
targets.task: Construct continuous signed-to-positive weights crossing zero while preserving moments; state hypotheses protecting a chosen invariant.

targets.title: Rational effect homogeneity
targets.task: Prove p(qA)=q*p(A) on E=[0,u] from partial additivity, checking that every evaluated effect remains in E.

targets.title: Effect monotonicity
targets.task: Derive p(A)<=p(B) from A<=B, nonnegative effect values and partial additivity.

targets.title: Order-unit extension
targets.task: Under declared order-unit and decomposition assumptions, extend an effect state uniquely and rational-linearly to its generated space.

targets.title: Real-place selection
targets.task: Specify the archimedean embedding/order and determine which coherent root choices fix weight comparisons; distinguish this from mere orientation.

targets.title: Torsion phase skeleton
targets.task: From phase subgroups of every finite order, derive characteristic zero, the directed root union and its abstract Q/Z structure.

targets.title: Cyclotomic rational-weight witnesses
targets.task: Derive square roots of nonnegative rationals in the cyclotomic union, distinguishing Gauss-sum proof from an imported theorem.

targets.title: Finite algebraic-witness ceiling
targets.task: State the exact equation/inequality language and prove the algebraic-to-complex witness transfer using a pinned real-closed-field result.

targets.title: Coefficient closure audit
targets.task: For one actual construction prove closure under inverses, required roots, spectral factors and tensor operations; declare extensions.

targets.title: Declared scalar completion
targets.task: Construct and characterize completion from a specified place and metric instead of inferring it from finitely many witnesses.

targets.title: Local-tomography scalar test
targets.task: For declared real/complex/quaternionic matrix and composite models derive dimensions and test the proposed multiplicativity requirement.

targets.title: Real effect homogeneity
targets.task: On the full real effect interval, use positivity and rational squeezing; never evaluate absent algebraic-carrier effects.

targets.title: Full-effect linear extension
targets.task: Derive a positive real-linear functional from normalized additive finite-Hermitian effect probabilities with explicit effect availability.

targets.title: Trace duality
targets.task: Prove each real-linear Hermitian-matrix functional has a unique Hermitian rho with L(A)=Tr(rho*A).

targets.title: Density positivity and trace
targets.task: Derive rho>=0 and Tr(rho)=1 from nonnegative normalized effect probabilities, including dimension one.

targets.title: Reconstructed coefficient field
targets.task: Determine whether rho lies in the original field or its completion from the probability codomain and input assumptions.

targets.title: Qubit projective exception
targets.task: Construct a continuous normalized nonquadratic qubit frame function; distinguish projective from full-effect additivity.

targets.title: Exact Gleason interface
targets.task: Pin the full-complex dimension-at-least-three theorem's hypotheses and separate that import from a finite-carrier proof.

targets.title: Dense-carrier extension theorem
targets.task: Assume uniform continuity and frame density, then prove extension to all complex frames before applying a full-space theorem.

targets.title: Algebraic frame density
targets.task: Prove algebraic complex orthonormal frames approximate arbitrary complex frames, tracking exact roots and normalization.

targets.title: Born missing-premise discharge
targets.task: For the actual carrier prove the required extension/regularity principle or supply a countermodel; finite agreement is insufficient.

targets.title: Kraus normalization
targets.task: Prove complete positivity and trace preservation from sum K_j* K_j=I, including rectangular dimensions.

targets.title: Choi factorization field
targets.task: Over a declared real-closed field and complexification derive Gram/Kraus factors, tracking rank and scalar closure.

targets.title: Finite Choi criterion
targets.task: Prove CP iff the convention-fixed Choi matrix is PSD and derive its trace-preserving partial-trace constraint.

targets.title: Positive versus CP
targets.task: Prove transpose is positive and trace preserving but not CP using an exact Bell partial-transpose witness.

targets.title: Available-ancilla Stinespring
targets.task: Construct the dilation/isometry and unitary extension while stating ancillary dimensions and physical availability.

targets.title: Rational Kraus descent
targets.task: Determine when Q(i) channel data admit Q(i) Kraus factors; distinguish Gram factorization from individual square roots.

targets.title: POVM/instrument nonuniqueness
targets.task: Exhibit distinct CP instruments for the same effects and state what selects one state update.

targets.title: Kraus representation coherence
targets.task: Prove isometric mixing invariance and the converse with correct padding/rank/partial-isometry hypotheses.

targets.title: Physical tensor selection
targets.task: Separate the tensor universal property from operational positivity, local tomography and system-availability assumptions.

targets.title: Object completeness
targets.task: Show why qubit tensor powers alone miss dimensions and prove how available projection faces recover all finite sizes.

targets.title: Generator aliasing
targets.task: Construct different Hermitian logarithms with the same sampled unitary, including branch freedom in degenerate eigenspaces.

targets.title: Dyadic continuity gap
targets.task: Construct compatible dyadic roots not continuous at zero, or derive an exact continuity criterion; compatibility alone does not suffice.

targets.title: Dyadic-to-real evolution
targets.task: Extend a dyadic-time unitary homomorphism continuous at zero to real time, then invoke Stone with its stated hypotheses.

targets.title: Band-limited logarithm uniqueness
targets.task: Prove uniqueness in a declared half-open spectral band of width 2pi/tau and handle the endpoint.

targets.title: Parallelogram and polarization
targets.task: Derive the complex inner product and characterize compatibility with a previously declared quadratic form.

targets.title: Graph-growth compatibility
targets.task: Determine separately when zero extension commutes with incidence and adjoint divergence; include boundary counterexamples.

targets.title: Subdivision isometry
targets.task: Derive weights and refinement maps for function versus density cochains and prove the correct additivity requirements.

targets.title: Stone-space Hilbert limit
targets.task: Construct measure and dense locally constant functions from countable refinements; require atomlessness before a Cantor conclusion.

targets.title: Galerkin resolvents
targets.task: From a closed positive form and dense stage form core prove projected resolvent convergence without false operator-domain assumptions.

targets.title: Evolution convergence
targets.task: Under the correct self-adjoint/resolvent hypotheses prove strong unitary convergence, tracking projections and time uniformity.

targets.title: Bell inequalities from a joint table
targets.task: Derive all CHSH inequalities and marginal consistency from a nonnegative joint law on four binary variables.

targets.title: Fine converse
targets.task: From valid binary pair marginals, consistency and the full inequality system construct a nonnegative joint table.

targets.title: Rational joint witnesses
targets.task: Prove rational feasible Bell marginal data admit a rational joint table with exactly checkable entries.

targets.title: Exact Bell separators
targets.task: Derive a rational dual/Farkas witness for an infeasible joint-extension LP.

targets.title: CHSH supremum versus attainment
targets.task: For an explicit field and state/measurement class determine the supremum, attainment and effects of scalar extension.

targets.title: Contextuality obstruction scope
targets.task: Prove the sound obstruction-to-no-global-section implication for a declared cover and test unsupported converses.

targets.title: Coefficient-sensitive contextuality
targets.task: Compute one cover with integer and cyclotomic coefficients and prove the operational meaning of the difference.

targets.title: Exact MUB equations
targets.task: Derive orthonormality and unbiasedness polynomial constraints, scalar requirements and allowed symmetries.

targets.title: Sound MUB enclosure pruning
targets.task: Prove residual bounds and pruning invariants that preserve every feasible assignment, including seams and repeated-box occupancy.

targets.title: Global d=6 MUB target
targets.task: Construct four exact bases or a rigorously covered global exclusion certificate; local rejected boxes are insufficient.

targets.title: Exact cochain optimization duality
targets.task: Derive rational primal/dual certificates for a declared finite L1 boundary problem and prove the optimum check.

targets.title: Local closure versus global exactness
targets.task: Exhibit d1*r=0 with r outside im(d0), and prove the required homology-sensitive classifier distinction.

targets.title: Physical effect availability
targets.task: After effect/trace representation, prove or explicitly declare which mathematical effects the theory physically realizes.

targets.title: Reconstruction product hypotheses
targets.task: State Jordan/composite assumptions and prove the product/trace identities before importing any classification result.

targets.title: Certified entropy enclosures
targets.task: For an algebraic density matrix derive rational entropy bounds with a proved remainder, zero-eigenvalue handling and fixed log base.

targets.title: Controlled CCR limit
targets.task: Prove finite trace obstruction and specify embeddings, scaling and domains for a genuine Weyl/CCR continuum limit.

targets.title: Controlled continuum equation
targets.task: Derive one specified lattice-to-Schrodinger or Dirac limit with explicit errors, geometry, dispersion and boundary assumptions.

targets.title: Collected-operation law proofs
targets.task: Prove typed domains, admissibility, identity and composition; distinguish an operation record from a verified operad.

targets.title: Independent native/formal transport
targets.task: Implement exact Rust/Python instances and formalize the actual Lean statement, binding sources, fixtures and rejected mutations.

targets.title: Integrated conditional reconstruction
targets.task: Assemble a coherent QM reconstruction/equivalence with every imported assumption and remaining obligation explicit.

evidence_contract: Precise statement, declared domain and all assumptions
Complete proof or explicit failed step/countermodel
Preserve user/provider original and independent review separately
Record reusable operation signatures and laws when a construction actually has them; do not invent an operad per lemma
Only mark exact replay, compilation or kernel verification after executing the relevant check
Finite controls, conditional theorem and new physical/asymptotic result have separate statuses
